name: vikrants-dev-studio
description: An 8-agent software team for Claude Code with a pixel-art office — built so non-developers can describe, approve, open and use what the team makes.

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=120000 tools/team-office/test/unit.test.mjs tools/team-office/test/team-cli.test.mjs tools/team-office/test/projects.test.mjs tools/team-office/test/server.test.mjs tools/team-office/test/launcher.test.mjs
scripts.check: node -e "for (const d of ['tools/team-office', 'tools/team-office/public', 'tools/team-office/test']) for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync(d)) if (/\.m?js$/.test(f)) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', d + '/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
